description: Change a subtask. Set completed to the value you want: true ticks it and false reopens it, and calling either twice changes nothing. Only the fields passed change.

assignee_id.description: The one person who does it, from list_people

completed.description: true when the step is done, false to reopen it

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID, as list_workspaces gives it. Defaults to the one workspace this connection reaches; required when it reaches several.

name: update_subtask
title: Update a subtask
